doc: Corpora registers as a handoff plugin, declaring the judgment-engine fields it expects on every handoff it processes at its ratify gate. Praxis's handoff engine composes these into the schema without knowing what any of them mean -- it only enforces presence. This is the corpora coupling for handoffs, isolated to one manifest; eventually corpora ships this file and praxis merely discovers it.
